column2: Create the Imperial Colleges of Magic

Since the days of Sigmar, magic has been a crime in the Empire and its wielders have burned. Yet the Empire's enemies bring sorcerers to every war. It is time to sign the Articles of Imperial Magic: to gather the gifted into eight licensed Orders, one for each Wind, bound by Imperial law and sworn to march with our armies.
Create a new College of Magic

Our gifted are hunted as witches while our enemies field sorcerers. It is time to found a College of Magic of our own, where those born with the gift can be trained, licensed and kept in the service of the realm.
No College of Magic stands in your de jure empire.

Warpstone is unbelievably dangerous and corrupting, not to mention illegal, yet the idea of storing magic for later use still has merit. Discovering a safe way to do it would make me renowned throughout the Colleges!

The Power Stone of our Wind has yet to be crafted. The glory of the first Power Stone forged by human hands has gone to another, but I can still be the first to craft one for the [GetCollegeOrderCharacterIsPartOf]!
The craft of the Power Stone is well understood, but it still takes great skill to make one.
